label: SC-41
title: Port and I/O Device Access

statement.prose: {{ insert: param, sc-41_odp.02 }} disable or remove {{ insert: param, sc-41_odp.01 }} on the following systems or system components: {{ insert: param, sc-41_odp.03 }}.

guidance: Connection ports include Universal Serial Bus (USB), Thunderbolt, and Firewire (IEEE 1394). Input/output (I/O) devices include compact disc and digital versatile disc drives. Disabling or removing such connection ports and I/O devices helps prevent the exfiltration of information from systems and the introduction of malicious code from those ports or devices. Physically disabling or removing ports and/or devices is the stronger action.

params.label: connection ports or input/output devices
guidelines: connection ports or input/output devices to be disabled or removed are defined;

params.label: systems or system components
guidelines: systems or system components with connection ports or input/output devices to be disabled or removed are defined;
